## Extraction evidence

Pricing algorithms are the dominant form in the digital economy today. This raises grave antitrust concerns regarding autonomous collusion. Although economists have proven that simple table-based agents are able to collude through the application of economic theory, the same cannot be said for the more advanced Deep Learning agents. This study attempts to bridge the knowledge gap. This study employs a simulation to replicate the repeated Bertrand Duopoly competition between the three models: Q-Learning, Sarsa, and Deep Q-Networks (DQN).
